scene: Arlequino tells Borga he wants the next concert to be large and that he is going to the palace now. Borga accepts that yesterday's trial met his condition sufficiently to support escalation, but cannot personally grant palace access or final use of the main assembly field. He will back the venue request through his own chain while Arlequino independently goes to the palace.

plans.arlequino: go to palace now; pursue large concert
plans.borga: support request for larger military assembly field through competent authority
